nodes.name: link_selector.js
nodes.summary: Dialog-based Link selector UI for searching and picking Link field values, supporting grid insertion, quantity prompts and dynamic link fields. Also defines frappe.link_search helper.

nodes.name: LinkSelector
nodes.summary: frappe.ui.form.LinkSelector: dialog to search and select a Link value for a form/grid field.

nodes.name: constructor
nodes.summary: Initializes LinkSelector with options and loads doctype metadata before calling make().

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Builds the search dialog with a text input, results area and More button.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Runs a link search via frappe.link_search and renders result rows with click handlers for selection.

nodes.name: set_in_grid
nodes.summary: Adds or updates a grid row with the selected value, optionally prompting for quantity or handling dynamic link references.

nodes.name: link_search
nodes.summary: Global helper that calls frappe.desk.search.search_widget to retrieve link search results.

nodes.name: linked_with.js
nodes.summary: Dialog showing documents linked to the current form document, fetched from frappe.desk.form.linked_with.get.

nodes.name: LinkedWith
nodes.summary: frappe.ui.form.LinkedWith: lists documents linked to the current document in a dialog.

nodes.name: show
nodes.summary: Shows the linked documents dialog, creating it first if needed.

nodes.name: make_dialog
nodes.summary: Creates the dialog and wires on_page_show to fetch linked docs and render HTML.

nodes.name: make_html
nodes.summary: Renders linked documents grouped by doctype into the dialog body.

nodes.name: make_doc_head
nodes.summary: Returns the header markup for a doctype section.

nodes.name: make_hidden_count_row
nodes.summary: Renders a row summarizing restricted/hidden linked documents count.

nodes.name: make_doc_row
nodes.summary: Renders a single linked document row with link to its desk page.

nodes.name: multi_select_dialog.js
nodes.summary: Multi-select search dialog used for picking multiple records, with filter setters, custom filter groups, child table selection and datatable rendering.

nodes.name: MultiSelectDialog
nodes.summary: frappe.ui.form.MultiSelectDialog: a dialog with search, filters and selection of multiple records including optional child item selection.

nodes.name: constructor
nodes.summary: Initializes the dialog options and loads doctype metadata before calling init().

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Sets page length, builds field definitions and creates the dialog.

nodes.name: get_fields
nodes.summary: Combines primary filters, result fields, data fields and child selection fields for the dialog layout.

nodes.name: get_result_fields
nodes.summary: Returns the results HTML area and the More button for paginated search results.

nodes.name: get_data_fields
nodes.summary: Adds user-provided data_fields after a section break.

nodes.name: get_child_selection_fields
nodes.summary: Adds child item selection UI fields when allow_child_item_selection is set.

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Instantiates the frappe.ui.Dialog, wires primary action, filter group and results setup.

nodes.name: make_new_document
nodes.summary: Opens a new document with route options based on setters when user requests creation.

nodes.name: set_route_options
nodes.summary: Populates frappe.route_options with current setter values for new document creation.

nodes.name: setup_results
nodes.summary: Renders the initial results area wrapper and triggers an initial search.

nodes.name: show_child_results
nodes.summary: Fetches child results and renders them in the child datatable.

nodes.name: is_child_selection_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether the allow-child-item-selection checkbox is currently toggled on.

nodes.name: toggle_child_selection
nodes.summary: Toggles between parent and child result display when child selection mode changes.

nodes.name: render_child_datatable
nodes.summary: Creates or refreshes the child datatable with current child results.

nodes.name: get_child_datatable_columns
nodes.summary: Builds column definitions for the child datatable from configured child columns.

nodes.name: get_child_datatable_rows
nodes.summary: Returns truncated child rows for the datatable according to page length.

nodes.name: setup_child_datatable
nodes.summary: Instantiates a DataTable for child item selection with checkboxes and More button.

nodes.name: get_primary_filters
nodes.summary: Builds the search text and setter filter fields used as primary filters in the dialog.

nodes.name: make_filter_area
nodes.summary: Sets up an advanced filter group area and hooks it into the results refresh.

nodes.name: get_custom_filters
nodes.summary: Collects filters configured in the advanced filter group into a filters object.

nodes.name: bind_events
nodes.summary: Binds click events on result rows for checkbox toggling and selection synchronization.

nodes.name: get_parent_name_of_selected_children
nodes.summary: Returns the unique parent names from currently checked child rows.

nodes.name: get_selected_child_names
nodes.summary: Returns names of child rows currently checked in the datatable.

nodes.name: get_checked_values
nodes.summary: Returns primary record names (or child child-table data) for checked rows in parent result list.

nodes.name: get_checked_items
nodes.summary: Returns the full result objects that are currently selected.

nodes.name: get_datatable_columns
nodes.summary: Returns configured columns or a default name column for the results list.

nodes.name: make_list_row
nodes.summary: Builds a single result row with checkbox, links and column values for the list.

nodes.name: render_result_list
nodes.summary: Renders list of results, handles empty state, header row, and More button visibility with optional auto scroll.

nodes.name: empty_list
nodes.summary: Clears all checkboxes and selection state in the results list.

nodes.name: get_filters_from_setters
nodes.summary: Builds filters and filter fields from configured setters based on their current values and fieldtype.

nodes.name: get_args_for_search
nodes.summary: Assembles search arguments (doctype, txt, filters, filter_fields, query) for the search_widget API.

nodes.name: perform_search
nodes.summary: Calls frappe.desk.search.search_widget and returns results plus a 'more' flag.

nodes.name: get_results
nodes.summary: Runs the main search, stores results and renders the result list.

nodes.name: get_filtered_parents_for_child_search
nodes.summary: Runs a parent search limited to name field, used to scope child item filters.

nodes.name: add_parent_filters
nodes.summary: Appends a [parent, in, parent_names] filter to scope child list results.

nodes.name: add_custom_child_filters
nodes.summary: Appends user-defined custom filters that target the child doctype to child list filters.

nodes.name: get_child_result
nodes.summary: Fetches child records via frappe.client.get_list using combined parent and custom filters.

nodes.name: print_utils.js
nodes.summary: Print utilities: dialog for print settings selection, and QZ Tray integration helpers for raw printing.

nodes.name: get_print_settings
nodes.summary: Shows a dialog to configure print options (letterhead, columns, filters) and invokes a callback with the chosen settings.

nodes.name: qz_connect
nodes.summary: Establishes a websocket connection to QZ Tray, initializing certificate and signature if needed.

nodes.name: qz_init
nodes.summary: Loads the QZ Tray library if not already present and resolves when ready.

nodes.name: qz_get_printer_list
nodes.summary: Connects to QZ and returns the list of available printers.

nodes.name: qz_success
nodes.summary: Shows a success alert when a QZ Tray print job succeeds.

nodes.name: qz_fail
nodes.summary: Handles QZ Tray errors, showing a user-friendly message for common connection issues.

nodes.name: quick_entry.js
nodes.summary: Quick entry dialog form for fast creation of records with only mandatory fields, supporting custom QuickEntryForm subclasses per doctype.

nodes.name: quick_edit
nodes.summary: Opens a QuickEntryForm for editing an existing record by doctype and name.

nodes.name: QuickEntryForm
nodes.summary: frappe.ui.form.QuickEntryForm extends frappe.ui.Dialog to render a lightweight dialog for new/quick document creation with mandatory fields only.

nodes.name: constructor
nodes.summary: Initializes the quick entry form with doctype, after_insert hook, init callback and optional existing doc.

nodes.name: setup
nodes.summary: Loads meta, decides if quick entry is viable, creates and renders the dialog or falls back to full form.

nodes.name: set_meta_and_mandatory_fields
nodes.summary: Populates this.meta and docfields with mandatory/required fields from the doctype metadata.

nodes.name: check_quick_entry_doc
nodes.summary: Ensures this.doc is set, creating a new local doc if needed.

nodes.name: is_quick_entry
nodes.summary: Returns whether the doctype is marked quick-entry and has a reasonable set of required fields.

nodes.name: too_many_mandatory_fields
nodes.summary: Returns true if more than 7 mandatory fields exist, disabling quick entry.

nodes.name: has_child_table
nodes.summary: Returns true if any mandatory field is a child table fieldtype.

nodes.name: validate_for_prompt_autoname
nodes.summary: Inserts a name field when autoname is set to 'prompt'.

nodes.name: render_dialog
nodes.summary: Creates the dialog with current fields, registers actions, sets intro and renders it.

nodes.name: get_title
nodes.summary: Returns a human-readable title for the quick entry dialog.

nodes.name: register_primary_action
nodes.summary: Wires the dialog primary action to update the doc and call insert() (or skip insert) with after-save hooks.

nodes.name: handle_after_callbacks
nodes.summary: Runs after_insert and calling-link update callbacks after the doc is saved.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Saves the new doc via frappe.db.insert, handles success/error, and closes the dialog.

nodes.name: submit
nodes.summary: Submits the given doc and resolves after process_after_insert.

nodes.name: process_after_insert
nodes.summary: Calls after_insert, updates calling link and optionally opens the full form if not in list view.

nodes.name: setup_cmd_enter_for_save
nodes.summary: Binds Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to trigger the dialog primary action.

nodes.name: open_form_if_not_list
nodes.summary: Opens the full form route for the doc unless the user is already on its list.

nodes.name: update_doc
nodes.summary: Copies dialog field values back into the doc object.

nodes.name: open_doc
nodes.summary: Opens the full form for the doc, optionally registering after_insert hook.

nodes.name: render_edit_in_full_page_link
nodes.summary: Adds a footer link to switch to full form editing.

nodes.name: set_intro
nodes.summary: Sets or clears the dialog intro message.

nodes.name: set_df_property
nodes.summary: Proxies set_df_property on the dialog for a given fieldname.

nodes.name: toggle_display
nodes.summary: Shows or hides a set of fields in the dialog.

nodes.name: toggle_enable
nodes.summary: Enables or disables a set of fields in the dialog.

nodes.name: toggle_reqd
nodes.summary: Toggles the required flag on a set of fields.

nodes.name: _apply_on_fields
nodes.summary: Utility that applies a function to one or many field names.

nodes.name: set_defaults
nodes.summary: Sets default values from the doc into the dialog field inputs.

nodes.name: reminders.js
nodes.summary: Reminder creation dialog for documents, converting selected period/datetime into a scheduled notification via frappe.core.doctype.notification_log API.

nodes.name: ReminderManager
nodes.summary: Exported ReminderManager: dialog to create a reminder for the current form document.

nodes.name: constructor
nodes.summary: Stores the frm reference for the reminder manager.

nodes.name: show
nodes.summary: Builds and shows the reminder dialog with relative/absolute time selectors.

nodes.name: _update_datetime_selector
nodes.summary: Toggles between period and datetime inputs based on the selected remind_at value.

nodes.name: _convert_period_to_absolute_time
nodes.summary: Converts a relative period like '10 minutes' into an absolute datetime.

nodes.name: create_reminder
nodes.summary: Calls the server to create a reminder notification for the current doc.

nodes.name: save.js
nodes.summary: Form save lifecycle: handles Save/Submit/Update/Amend/Cancel flows, mandatory field validation, workflow state and post-save link update.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: frappe.ui.form.save: top-level save routine that validates mandatory fields, freezes UI and dispatches insert/update/submit/cancel via frappe.call.

nodes.name: check_mandatory
nodes.summary: Validates mandatory fields on the document and child tables, scrolls to missing ones and shows a msgprint.

nodes.name: remove_old_form_route
nodes.summary: Removes the current form route from route history after save navigation.

nodes.name: update_calling_link
nodes.summary: Updates the link field in the calling form after a new document is inserted via quick entry/new doc link.

nodes.name: script_helpers.js
nodes.summary: Global helpers exposed on window for legacy client scripts: refresh_field, refresh_many, set_field_options, toggle_field, hide_field, unhide_field.

nodes.name: refresh_many
nodes.summary: Refreshes a list of fields, optionally for a grid row.

nodes.name: refresh_field
nodes.summary: Refreshes a single form or grid field, updating its meta if it belongs to a child table.

nodes.name: set_field_options
nodes.summary: Sets the options df property of a field on the current form.

nodes.name: toggle_field
nodes.summary: Hides or shows a field on the current form by updating its hidden flag.

nodes.name: hide_field
nodes.summary: Hides one or several fields on the current form.

nodes.name: unhide_field
nodes.summary: Shows one or several previously hidden fields on the current form.

nodes.name: script_manager.js
nodes.summary: Script manager that registers and triggers form event handlers (doctype client scripts, custom scripts, and frappe.ui.form.on handlers) for the current form.

nodes.name: extend_cscript
nodes.summary: Extends a cscript object with a controller's methods and prototype for client scripts.

nodes.name: get_event_handler_list
nodes.summary: Returns (creating if necessary) the event handler array for a given doctype and fieldname.

nodes.name: on
nodes.summary: Registers form event handlers for a doctype, fieldname and callback, supporting object map form and immediate trigger for setup on current form.

nodes.name: off
nodes.summary: Removes all event handlers for a given doctype/fieldname from global and current form caches.

nodes.name: trigger
nodes.summary: Triggers a named event on the current form via its script manager.

nodes.name: ScriptManager
nodes.summary: frappe.ui.form.ScriptManager: orchestrates setup and triggering of client scripts (controller, custom cscripts, form handlers) for a form.

nodes.name: constructor
nodes.summary: Initializes the script manager bound to a form instance.

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Instantiates a controller class for the form and extends its cscript.

nodes.name: trigger
nodes.summary: Calls all handlers for an event (doctype-specific, wildcard, cscript, custom_) and chains their returned promises.

nodes.name: has_handler
nodes.summary: Returns whether any handlers are registered for an event name.

nodes.name: has_handlers
nodes.summary: Returns whether specific handlers exist for a given doctype/event combination.

nodes.name: get_handlers
nodes.summary: Collects all handler functions registered for an event across doctype, wildcard, cscript and custom_ variants.

nodes.name: setup
nodes.summary: Runs DocType Layout client script, then __custom_js for the doctype, injecting them into the form scope.

nodes.name: log_error
nodes.summary: Logs client script errors with context to the console and optionally to a message.

nodes.name: copy_from_first_row
nodes.summary: Utility to copy fieldnames from the first row of a child table into a given current row.

nodes.name: section.js
nodes.summary: Form Section layout element: renders head/body, supports collapsible sections, labels, description, icons and missing-mandatory tracking.

nodes.name: Section
nodes.summary: Exported default Section class representing a section break in a form layout.

nodes.name: constructor
nodes.summary: Stores parent, df, layout and card_layout references and calls make().

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Builds the section DOM with optional label, description, css class and collapsible head.

nodes.name: make_head
nodes.summary: Builds the section head with label and collapsible toggle wiring.

nodes.name: replace_field
nodes.summary: Replaces an existing field's DOM and wiring with a new field object.

nodes.name: add_field
nodes.summary: Adds a new field to the section's fields list and dictionary.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Refreshes the section visibility based on the hide flag and missing mandatory state.

nodes.name: collapse
nodes.summary: Collapses or expands the section body, updating icon and triggering on_section_toggle.

nodes.name: set_icon
nodes.summary: Switches the collapsible chevron icon based on hide state.

nodes.name: set_label
nodes.summary: Updates the section label text.

nodes.name: is_collapsed
nodes.summary: Returns whether the section body is currently hidden.

nodes.name: has_missing_mandatory
nodes.summary: Checks whether the section contains any mandatory fields that are currently empty.

nodes.name: hide
nodes.summary: Hides the section by calling show(false).

nodes.name: show
nodes.summary: Shows or hides the section wrapper based on argument.

nodes.name: on_section_toggle
nodes.summary: Extensibility hook called when the section collapse state changes.
